library.help: Reads the .txt and .md files (UTF-8 text) and .texts.jsonl text bundles in the chosen folder and all its subfolders. A file NAME.txt.manifest.toml next to a text can give its title, punctuation conventions and date (era = "唐", year = 618, year_end = 907); otherwise the file name is the title. Other formats, such as Excel, are not read.
library.skipped: Files skipped because they could not be read (not UTF-8 text, a broken manifest, or not original text), {n} in all: {files}
source.label: Search source
source.itkc.note: Searches ITKC's classical originals (Classical Texts, the Korean Literary Collections, and Ilseongnok) online. ITKC returns an excerpt of about 150 characters around the match, cut at both ends, so results show only what the excerpt contains; the title opens the record on ITKC. The first 100 records per collection are checked. Nothing is stored.
error.itkc_alternatives: ITKC search takes one word per box, without |.
error.itkc_query: ITKC receives the words not excluded by NOT, combined with AND. CPE checks NOT, "phrase", and NEAR/n on the returned excerpts; OR and /regex/ are not available.
error.source_failed: The online source did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
error.source_cap: The request limit for this source has been reached for this session. Restart the app to search again.
source.ndl.note: Searches OCR text from NDL's classical books (NDL Lab). NDL requires a phrase of at least two characters. CPE sends the longer element or longest term and checks the remaining conditions in the supplied excerpts. OCR may contain recognition errors; excerpts have no punctuation and may be cut at both ends. Check the page image through the title link before citing. Only the first 50 books are checked. Nothing is stored.
source.ndl.summary: NDL: checked {books} of {total} books found for {phrase}
error.ndl_short: NDL finds only phrases of two or more characters. Make at least one search word two characters or longer, or search ITKC or your text folder.
error.ndl_alternatives: NDL requires a single phrase of at least two characters. At least one input box must contain such a phrase without |.
error.ndl_query: For NDL, enter at least one word or phrase not excluded by NOT. CPE sends one required phrase and checks the rest on the returned excerpts. OR and /regex/ are not available, and a query with only NOT has nothing to send.
source.cbeta.note: Searches the CBETA Buddhist canon online (CBData API). CPE sends the longer element or longest term. CBETA supplies about 40 characters on each side of each hit; CPE checks the remaining conditions in those excerpts. Interlinear notes are excluded. Only the first 50 juan are checked; titles open the corresponding juan in CBETA Online. Texts: CBETA Chinese Electronic Tripitaka Collection, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial use, attribution, share alike). Nothing is stored.
source.cbeta.summary: CBETA: checked {juans} of {total} juan found for {phrase}
error.cbeta_alternatives: CBETA receives one element as a single phrase. At least one input box must contain a phrase without |.
error.cbeta_query: CBETA receives one word or phrase not excluded by NOT. CPE checks the rest, including NOT and NEAR/n, on the returned excerpts; OR and /regex/ are not available.
source.docusky.note: Searches the 佛寺志靈應故事 public database on DocuSky: selected stories from 普陀洛迦新志 and 清涼山志, not the complete books. One element or word is sent; the first 50 returned records are checked here. Only isolated source paragraphs are searched; research tags and unsupported body text are excluded. Titles open the project page. Compiler: 曹德啓; data: 中華佛學研究所; platform: 臺灣大學數位人文研究中心. Personal, non-commercial research use under the provider's terms. Nothing is stored. The catalog also lists duplicate entries, metadata databases, and modern-language or translated databases. Only the reviewed database's body text has been inspected; every other entry is marked unreviewed.
source.docusky.summary: DocuSky: {records} of {total} records found for {phrase}; {accepted} checked, {excluded} excluded
source.nrich.note: Loads up to 600 public wooden-tablet records and searches their supplied transcriptions, including Idu. This loaded set is not the full database and is reused in later searches. Results are candidate references whose characters match your input; transcription notation is kept as supplied. Confirm pattern suitability from the original material; it is not judged automatically. The first load may take a little while. Personal non-commercial research only. Loaded material is not automatically saved to files.
source.nrich.query_hint: For NRICH, use {single_search} with one word or phrase. {compound_search} and query operators are not supported.
source.nrich.candidates: Exact character matches in the transcriptions (candidates)
source.nrich.candidate_note: Exact character matches in the transcriptions supplied with the loaded records, including Idu. This does not cover the whole database or establish pattern suitability; check the original material.
source.nrich.summary: NRICH: {items} matches for “{phrase}” in {rows} loaded records; the load limit is {cap} records.
source.nrich.summary_capped: NRICH: {items} matches for “{phrase}” in {rows} loaded records. Loading stopped at the {cap}-record limit.
source.nrich.summary_short: NRICH: {items} matches for “{phrase}” in {rows} loaded records. The supplied list ended before the {cap}-record load limit.
source.sillok: Annals of the Joseon Dynasty, NIKH search
source.sillok.note: Searches the National Institute of Korean History's public Sillok search window with one word or phrase. The first page of original-text results, up to 50, is read; titles, excerpts, and links to the article pages are shown. This is a candidate search, not a full-text pattern match; the excerpt is truncated and results come from the provider's original-text tab. One query is sent at a time; later result pages are not requested, and nothing is stored. Personal non-commercial research.
source.sillok.summary: Sillok search: {items} of {total} original-text results for "{phrase}", first page
source.ith: Academia Sinica ITH Taiwan Full-text Database
source.ith.note: Searches the Institute of Taiwan History's public Taiwan Full-text Database with one word or phrase. The first result page is read; candidate titles, excerpts, and provider links are shown. This is a candidate search, not a full-text pattern match. No pagination, article-page requests, or storage; cite the provider.
source.ith.summary: ITH search: {items} first-page candidate results for "{phrase}"

source.historydb.note: Searches the NIKH Korean History Database public search window by era and database item. Sends one word or phrase and reads only the first page, up to 20 rows, of the original-text tab. Titles, excerpts, and provider links are shown; there is no pagination, article-page request, or storage. Candidate references, not a full-text pattern match. Personal non-commercial research.

source.nahf: NAHF Northeast Asian History Net search
source.nahf.note: Searches one collection of the Northeast Asian History Foundation's public source library with one word or phrase. The first page of original-text results, up to 20 rows, is read; titles, excerpts, and provider links are shown. The main search page gives counts only, so choose a collection first. This is a candidate search, not a full-text pattern match. No pagination, article-page requests, or storage. Personal non-commercial research.

error.docusky_alternatives: DocuSky receives one element. At least one input box must contain a single term without |.
error.docusky_query: DocuSky supports AND, NOT, "phrase", and NEAR/n here, with at least one term that is not excluded by NOT and contains only letters or numbers. OR and /regex/ are unavailable.
source.cyberseodang.note: Searches the Dongyang Classics DB (Cyber Seodang) of the Institute of Traditional Culture via its Open API. The server returns records with titles, descriptions, and article links. Results display the returned text with links to the original articles on Cyber Seodang; full body text and context are not guaranteed, and the returned records do not establish whether a field is original text or translation, so unverified records remain candidates. Up to 50 records are checked. Nothing is stored.

source.vietdien.note: Searches the public Việt Điện OCR search of the Digitizing Vietnam Hán-Nôm corpus, one word or phrase at a time. Only the first page, up to 20 page-level hits, is read; each result shows the OCR excerpt and opens the page viewer on Việt Điện. The OCR is machine-generated and uncorrected, and the provider also matches other glyph forms and simplified/traditional variants, so a returned hit is a candidate reference unless the excerpt contains the exact characters you entered. Page and item metadata may be missing or uneven; image and record rights are separate from the OCR research-use statement. Nothing is stored.

source.sat.note: Searches the University of Tokyo SAT Daizōkyō Text Database with one word or phrase. Only the first group of up to 30 line hits is read; each result shows the Taishō page and line range, a keyword-in-context excerpt and a detail link. The excerpt is cut at both ends, and image-only glyphs are kept as □. SAT's Taishō text overlaps the connected CBETA canon, so this route adds line references rather than new holdings. Terms distinguish scholarly or nonprofit text use; image collections are separate. No pagination, detail-page fetch or storage.

source.aksarchive.note: Searches the Academy of Korean Studies manuscript archive at archive.aks.ac.kr, one word or phrase at a time. Only the first page of the original-text group, up to 20 rows, is read; each result shows the manuscript title, a highlighted transcription excerpt, a date if supplied, and a link to the archive's record page. The excerpt is cut at both ends and keeps the source notation; image viewers and record bodies are not fetched. source.ships: University of Tokyo Old Japanese Diaries · official search
source.ships.note: Opens the University of Tokyo Historiographical Institute's public 古記録フルテキストデータベース (full-text database of historical diaries) in your browser. It searches diary texts in kanbun, including Teishinkoki and Kyureki, across the database. Use one keyword without spaces. The official page provides excerpts, source dates, volume and page references, and available image links. Editorial notes and uncertain characters remain as supplied. This connection does not fetch, store or verify results inside CPE. Scholarly use only; retain attribution and follow the Institute's restrictions on redistribution.

source.thdl: Taiwan History Digital Library · Old Deeds
source.thdl.note: Searches THDL's Old Deeds collection with one keyword without spaces, across document text and metadata. Reads only the first ten results, keeping returned characters, excerpts and source references. Excerpts can contain separated contexts, uncertain characters and editorial material; these are candidate references, not verified sentences or grammatical matches. A single-result page may supply more text; CPE displays at most 600 characters. Source titles open the official document. No pagination, separate article request or text storage. Ming/Qing administrative archives and Tan-Hsin files are outside this connection. Cite THDL and each document's original source; personal non-commercial research only, with no redistribution.

source.csid: Zhejiang University Chinese Stone Inscription Database · transcription search
source.csid.note: Searches the transcription field of Zhejiang University's Chinese Stone Inscription Database across its seven default collections. Uses the provider's public HTTP search, one keyword without spaces, and reads only the first 15 references. The list supplies titles, dynasties, source dates, object types and catalog numbers, without transcription excerpts. CPE does not verify a character, sentence or grammatical match. Open a title to inspect the official record. Returned duplicate references remain visible. The site requests traditional characters; CPE sends your characters unchanged. Holdings include later material and are not all established as Literary Sinitic. No next page, article body or image is fetched or stored. Personal non-commercial research only; retain Zhejiang University and record attribution.

source.cand: CanD Chinese and Japanese poetry · references
source.cand.note: Searches the body field of Hankeidou's privately edited CanD poetry database across its collections, including Japanese anthologies. Uses one keyword of up to 10 characters without spaces or wildcards, with provider variant expansion OFF. Reads one native response and displays its first 20 bibliographic headings, retaining titles, authors and native source locators. The response also contains poems and Japanese readings; CPE discards those bodies and commentary. No sentence, literal occurrence or grammatical match is verified. Titles open the provider's edition overview, not an individual poem. Returned characters remain unchanged; the provider edits glyphs and punctuation. Chinese works partly overlap existing sources; institution-wide overlap is unmeasured. No pagination, separate text request or storage. Personal non-commercial research only; retain CanD and edition attribution and respect the provider's copying restrictions.

source.kyudb.note: Searches Seoul National University's Kyujanggak historical-document database (GMS), one keyword without spaces, up to 80 characters. Reads only the first 20 references from one native response. Shows titles, document numbers, parties, source dates, types and available inline original-text excerpts, at most 600 characters. Some results supply metadata only; lazy content is not requested. Transcriptions can contain Idu, uncertainty and editorial notation; language and sentence boundaries are not determined. No grammatical match or grade is assigned. Titles open the official original-text viewer. Old books, chronicle collections, royal protocols and modern-government groups are outside this route. Overlap with other institutional document holdings is unmeasured. No next page, additional article text, image or translation is fetched or stored. Personal non-commercial research only; retain Kyujanggak and document attribution, with no redistribution.
